title: FortisAVQA and MAVEN: a Benchmark Dataset and Debiasing Framework for Robust Multimodal Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Rephrasing test questions to increase linguistic diversity, evaluating models' reliance on spurious statistical correlations between key question words and answers, and employing a language-only bias learner to isolate text-based dependencies.
Employing a video-only bias learner during training to capture and subsequently penalize predictions that rely solely on visual inputs without proper multimodal reasoning.
Employing an audio-only bias learner during training to capture and mitigate the model's reliance on isolated audio cues, ensuring predictions require multimodal context.

Categorizing the dataset's questions into frequent (head) and rare (tail) answer distributions using conformal-inspired optimization to evaluate the models' robustness in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios.
